files.path: SUPPLEMENTARY swapi-graphql schema.graphql (1166 lines, over the limit)

rule_objections: No fixtures/langs/graphql exists: no stated rule. Counted types, interfaces, unions, enums, inputs, scalars, directives and top-level operations/fragments (none of the latter occur in these files). Enum values and fields were counted as NOT definitions; if the (unstated) intent is to index enum values, the 5 'spurious' would be correct.

Kinds: scalars (Time, UUID, Int64) and directives (goField) are recorded as kind `function`, enums/input/union as `class`, interface as `interface`. `function` for a scalar or a directive is odd; a scalar is a type.
Enum values get kind `function` but fields, arguments and input fields are not recorded: inconsistent.
findings: Enum values are indexed (5 in starwars/schema.graphql) as `function` symbols named NEWHOPE, EMPIRE, JEDI, METER, FOOT, while field names and input fields are not. 5 spurious under my rule.

A type preceded by a `"""description"""` line gets the description line as its start_line (52 of 53 types in swapi schema.graphql, e.g. Film reported at line 5, declaration on line 6); counted as line_on_attribute. Types with `#` comments above or no description are on the declaration line.
Everything else matched: 95 expected, 95 found, names right, 0 missed. All files parse ok. `schema { query: Root }` (swapi:1) is not recorded, which I did not count as a definition.
Text search works (`search jedi` finds starwars/schema.graphql).
not_done: No `query`/`mutation`/`subscription` operation documents or fragments among the files, so those forms were not exercised. graphiql's and swapi's larger/other .graphql files are tests or over 800 lines. The three picked files are small (76-135 lines).
